question: What meditative focus must precede recitation of the root mantra?
premises: Meditation on the form of Sadāśiva is prescribed.
The root mantra is the object of recitation.
inference: Having meditated on the form of Sadāśiva, one should recite the root mantra.
plain_english: Having meditated on the form of Sadāśiva, one should recite the root mantra.
